_about: Scanned trees (Quixel Megaplants, free on Fab) for Ride UK, by the ride's tree kinds (World/WorldRidePlants.cpp). Tools/ue_build_rideuk.py looks for static meshes anywhere under /Game whose path holds one of a kind's words (case, spaces and underscores ignored) and uses them in place of Buttertubs' own models of that kind. A kind with none found keeps ours; oak, beech, willow, rowan, pine and hazel then fall back to ash, sycamore, alder, birch, spruce and hawthorn. There is no Megaplants ash or hawthorn. 'skip' words leave out parts that aren't whole trees; 'most' caps the models per kind.
_enabled: hub, round 143: off. Megaplants whole trees are SkeletalMesh / ProceduralVegetation assets; the only StaticMeshes are leaf, bud and decoration parts, which got planted as trees. Since 144 scanned_trees() turns the whole-tree SkeletalMeshes into static Nanite copies (Geometry Script, /Game/ScannedTrees: outside the always-cooked /Game/RideUK, so they cook only when planted) and, while off, logs a trial of what it would plant. Turn on once that log names whole trees. Build 147: ON (beenster asked where the Megaplants were); the copies' base materials are flagged for instanced static meshes and Nanite.
_impostors: Build 155: far trees (past torque.RideNearTreeM, 200 m, and the far ring) drawn as impostors baked from these scans by Tools/ue_tree_impostors.py into /Game/RideUK/Impostors, made once and kept; rebake_impostors true makes them again (after changing the bake).
_hedge_words: A scanned hedge (any static mesh under /Game whose path holds one of these) takes the place of our own hedge models (Tools/make_hedges.py) in hedgerows.
